messages:
Cheng: Quick async standup — model onboarding + evals snapshot.
Cheng: What I did: pushed Llama3-xxlq variant to staging (quantized q4_k_m), ran nightly evals against prompt_set_v2.
Cheng: Results: overall helpfulness 0.87 -> 0.84 vs baseline, 7 failing prompts (mostly instruction-following / code-block formatting). Link to eval dashboard: https://redwood.dev/evals/boards/1829
Mae: Can you paste one failing example? want to triage.
Cheng: Sure — failing prompt: "Explain why merge sort is O(n log n)" -> model truncates step-3 and outputs partial pseudo-code.
Cheng: Snippet:
```
Input: Explain merge sort complexity.
Output: 1) divide ... 2) conquer ... 3) merge... [truncated]
```
Jonah: Looks like KV cache eviction threshold too low for long code outputs. Which config used?
Cheng: Deploy config: `batch_size=16, max_tokens=512, kv_cache=true, kv_max_entries=65536`.
Rik: I suspect tokenizer differences in q4_k_m quant. Small off-by-one can cut output. I'll run a tokenizer diff.
Mae: I'll add failing prompts to prompt_set_v2/blocked and create a focused eval set.
EvalBot: nightly-eval: run_id=2026-03-16-03, tests_total=842, regressions=7, avg_helpfulness=0.84 (-0.03), top_fail_labels=[formatting, truncation]
Alex: PR incoming to bump kv_max_entries to 131072 and adjust batching: <https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/2468>
Priya: Pinged infra to verify mem reservation on staging GPUs, since bigger kv_cache bumps mem by ~1.2GB.
Jonah: I can review the PR later today — leaving a quick comment on coverage.
Rik: Blocker: if we flip kv_max_entries we might hit OOM on smallest staging instance. Suggest canary on a single shard first.
Cheng: Agreed — will canary to shard-5 tag and run evals; I'll post results here.
Mae: Thanks. Today I'll curate the 7 failed prompts into two buckets (format vs content) and write repro harness.
Priya: FYI — sales demo scheduled Friday uses the older Llama3-xxlq var. If we can stabilize by Thu EOD that'd be ideal.
Cheng: Noted. Timeline: canary today, rollback plan ready. I'll update thread with canary metrics.
EvalBot: canary-eval: shard-5 run_id=canary-1829, regressions=1 (formatting), avg_helpfulness=0.85
Jonah: Nice improvement. I'll follow up on PR review after standup.
Cheng: Thanks all — any other blockers?
Mae: none from me.
Priya: none.
Rik: none.
Jonah: n/a
EvalBot: archiver: logs saved to s3://redwood-evals/1829/canary-logs.tar.gz
Cheng: Closing this check-in, will reopen if canary fails. :thumbsup:
